$comment: Type gaps for webidl-ts-types.mjs: members the shim has but types differently, indexed getters it lacks ("[index]"), and parents it doesn't extend. A member the page lacks belongs in the conformance ledger, idl-gaps.json, not here. Each entry says why. Regenerate with pnpm webidl:generate.

omit.baseURI: the getter fallback returns null when no base URI is available

omit.cssRules: an array with item(), not a CSSRuleList: CSSRuleList isn't exposed

omit.h: may hold a CSSKeywordValue for none, which the pinned IDL's type doesn't allow
omit.w: may hold a CSSKeywordValue for none, which the pinned IDL's type doesn't allow
omit.b: may hold a CSSKeywordValue for none, which the pinned IDL's type doesn't allow
omit.alpha: may hold a CSSKeywordValue for none, which the pinned IDL's type doesn't allow

omit.[index]: no indexed getter; the keyframes are reachable through cssRules
omit.cssRules: an array with item(), not a CSSRuleList: CSSRuleList isn't exposed
an array with item(), not a CSSRuleList: CSSRuleList isn't exposed
omit.rules: an array with item(), not a CSSRuleList: CSSRuleList isn't exposed

omit.parseFromString: returns a ParsedDocument, which doesn't implement Document

omit.[index]: no indexed getter; the items are reachable by iteration

omit.all: the live document leaves it out: browsers make HTMLAllCollection falsy, which JS can't emulate, and a truthy value sends pages down old-IE paths
omit.styleSheets: returns an array of the sheets, not a StyleSheetList
omit.getElementsByName: returns an array, not a live NodeList
omit.createEvent: may return a BeforeUnloadEvent, whose string returnValue TypeScript can't relate to Event's boolean one

omit.scrollIntoView: returns undefined; CSSOM View now specifies a promise

omit.innerText: the shared wrapper also handles SVG and MathML elements, which return undefined
omit.outerText: delegates to innerText on the shared wrapper and may return undefined
omit.dataset: the shared wrapper also handles other namespaces, which return undefined

omit.[index]: no indexed getter; the controls are reachable through elements
omit.relList: shared Element accessor returns undefined for form; only a/area/link are supported

omit.blocking: returns an array stub, not a DOMTokenList

omit.textTracks: returns an object stub, not a TextTrackList: a track's cues stay empty and its events never fire
omit.addTextTrack: returns an object stub, not a TextTrack
omit.audioTracks: returns an empty array stub, not an AudioTrackList
omit.videoTracks: returns an empty array stub, not a VideoTrackList

omit.blocking: returns an array stub, not a DOMTokenList

omit.[index]: no indexed getter; the options are reachable through item() and options

omit.blocking: returns an array stub, not a DOMTokenList

omit.addedNodes: an array, not a NodeList: it has length and indexes but no item()
omit.removedNodes: an array, not a NodeList: it has length and indexes but no item()

omit.ownerNode: a DOMParser document's sheets are owned by a ParsedElement, which doesn't implement Element

omit.singleNodeValue: a DOMParser document's nodes are Parsed* wrappers, which don't implement Node
omit.iterateNext: a DOMParser document's nodes are Parsed* wrappers, which don't implement Node
omit.snapshotItem: a DOMParser document's nodes are Parsed* wrappers, which don't implement Node
